# devin_enterprise_blueprint (Resource)

Manages the enterprise-wide snapshot setup blueprint, which applies to every organization in the enterprise. An enterprise has at most one; creating a second fails. Changes don't start a build.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Applied to every organization in the enterprise.
resource "devin_enterprise_blueprint" "this" {
  contents = file("${path.module}/blueprints/enterprise.yaml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contents` (String) Blueprint YAML.

### Read-Only

- `blueprint_id` (String) Blueprint ID (assigned by Devin).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The enterprise blueprint is imported with its blueprint ID.
terraform import devin_enterprise_blueprint.this blueprint-24364480e58149da814b3aa2b3d0aa31
```
